# Deeplink

> Create deep links that open the right screen in your app or site. Deferred deep linking, universal links, Android App Links and click analytics.

Deeplink (deeplink.in) is a deep linking platform for mobile apps and websites. The canonical site is https://www.deeplink.in.

Website: https://www.deeplink.in
Documentation: https://docs.deeplink.in/
Docs index for AI agents: https://docs.deeplink.in/llms.txt
Signup: https://www.deeplink.in/signup
Support: info@deeplink.in

## Product pages

- [Home](https://www.deeplink.in/): What Deeplink is, how deep linking works, use cases, pricing, and FAQs
- [Features](https://www.deeplink.in/features): Smart links, deferred deep linking, analytics, APIs, and QR codes
- [Pricing](https://www.deeplink.in/pricing): Free plan and paid plans with monthly click limits
- [Deep linking platform](https://www.deeplink.in/deep-linking-platform): How Deeplink routes one link across Android, iOS, and web
- [Deferred deep linking](https://www.deeplink.in/deferred-deep-linking): Preserve click intent through app install to first open
- [App deep links](https://www.deeplink.in/app-deep-links): Universal Links, App Links, and fallbacks
- [Compare](https://www.deeplink.in/compare): Deeplink capabilities, with unverified competitor cells left blank
- [Free QR code generator](https://www.deeplink.in/free-qr-code-generator): Create a free QR PNG; create an account to track scans with smart links
- [Deep link tester](https://www.deeplink.in/deep-link-tester): Inspect scheme, host, path, and UTMs; create an account for tracked smart links
- [About](https://www.deeplink.in/about): Mission and product philosophy

## Guides

- [Guides index](https://www.deeplink.in/guides): All long-form deep linking guides
- [What is deep linking?](https://www.deeplink.in/guides/what-is-deep-linking): A URL that opens a specific screen, plus fallbacks
- [What is deferred deep linking?](https://www.deeplink.in/guides/deferred-deep-linking): Keeping the destination through install
- [Universal Links vs Android App Links](https://www.deeplink.in/guides/universal-links-vs-app-links): The two verified HTTPS link systems
- [Deep links in WhatsApp campaigns](https://www.deeplink.in/guides/deep-links-whatsapp-campaigns): Paste one URL into WhatsApp, email, or SMS
- [QR code deep links](https://www.deeplink.in/guides/qr-code-deep-links): A QR image of a Deeplink URL
